atct_1.172.inspection: Official displayed C, S and CS entries inspected; agrees with frozen major_molecule_reference.json. Complete network covariance not reaudited.

atct_1.228.inspection: Official displayed species tables and provenance inspected via browser; not raw-byte archived. Same version for molecule and both atoms. Entry errors are correlated and not combined into a reaction uncertainty. The +0.379 kJ/mol D0 change is a central-value diagnostic, not a statistically resolved disagreement. CS provenance includes Barman/Martin 2026 and Bell 1972; their primary determinations were not independently reaudited.

paulose2015.inspection: Full author manuscript and publisher HTML inspected; Sections 2.1/2.3, Tables 8/9/10/13. X 1 Sigma+ only, claimed at least 95% Q convergence at 3000 K. PEC De fixed 59300 cm-1 is not a D0 to insert in an atom-balanced reaction. No 4000 K claim.

JnK_distribution.inspection: Every current state energy/degeneracy/J/v replayed. Readme says updated 03/2016; def version 20160726. Current PF differs from paper Table 8; exact cause not established, and paper values are not silently overwritten. Metadata maxE 30000 disagrees with actual state range. No additional spin or symmetry factor for 12 C 32 S; gtot=2 J+1.

electronic_scale_source.inspection: Huber/Herzberg evaluated constants, data through 1976: five low excited terms inspected. Original experimental papers not reread. Constants used only for a coarse same-rovibration sensitivity, not a corrected partition sum.

li2022.inspection: Full publisher PDF inspected, Sections 2/3.1/4.1 and Table 1. Twelve Lambda-S potential curves are discussed but partition sums in Section 4.1 use the lowest three singlet states only. Thus the plotted Q is not a complete low-triplet-inclusive thermal evaluation.

coxon2023.inspection: Publisher abstract/introduction inspected, not full text or supplementary potential parameters. New seven-isotopologue direct potential fit uses 6759 observed lines; useful future precision study, not an acquisition gate for this review.

olivares2025.inspection: Full author preprint inspected, Sections II/III. BO model predicts 14562/14624 states and Jmax 289; warns near-threshold states depend on omitted corrections. No complete machine-readable state table or full electronic thermodynamic assessment used here.

legacy_sources.NASA: Frozen header: Hf:Prinslow, 1991; Gurvich, 1991 pt 1 p 206 pt 2 p 198. Those originals not reread. Native R 8.314510 kept in dimensionless functions.
legacy_sources.JANAF: Frozen C-098 evaluationDecember 1976 at 1 bar; native molecular/atomic comparison kept separate from fixed-D0/fixed-atom thermal comparison.
legacy_sources.Barklem_Collet: Frozen 2016 partition samples are a separate compilation with shared legacy spectroscopy; agreement is not statistically independent physical validation.

decision: Retain current NASA thermal functions and current production energy in this source-review PR. Prioritize a separately tested energy-only candidate using balancedATcT 1.228; do not claim the older energy is scientifically preferred. JnK ground-state sum does not justify a wholesale 4000 K thermal replacement.
follow_ups: Build energy-only candidate with same-version balancedATcT 1.228 D0 and test fixed-network sulfur redistribution before production adoption. No new historical full text is mandatory for this step.

For precision thermal replacement, reconcile currentJnK/paperPF and metadata, add electronic states with consistent zeros and converge Q, H, S, Cp; optionally use Coxon 2023 full text/supplement. Full physical uncertainty remainsunknown.
